text:
raja: CISO wants to reduce eu-west audit export to save S3 egress/retention. Proposal: sample noisy telemetry (keystore/KMS enrichments) down to 10% but keep auth/change events at 100%. Need quick ops risk sync.

linh: What exact event classes are "noisy"? VPC flow enrichment, header blobs, KV cache traces?

raja: Mostly flow/enrichment and debug-level keystore traces. Not auth, grant, or cross-account events. Estimate savings ~2.1TB/day.

yvonne: Strong caution. We lost key forensic signal in a prior test and that caused a delayed debug of a GPU join issue. If we do this we must have canary + auto rollback and rehydration plan.

ops-oncall: Agree. Canary plan suggestion: eu-west-1a sample 50% for 72h with synthetic decrypt probe and Prom rule to rollback if decrypt_error_rate > 0.4% over 5m. CLI toggle is a configmap patch.

raja: Also need compliance note explaining retention policy change and why critical audit paths remain full. @compliance-bot can you assign a ticket?

compliance-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-412. Assignees: yvonne (ops), linh (telemetry), raja (owners). Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-412

linh: I'll add dashboard showing sampled vs raw event counts and a p99 decrypt latency. We'll make rollback automatic and add a whitelist for events containing user_token, grant_id, or cross_account.

yvonne: Runbook draft: toggle sampling, verify probe, monitor 24h, revert if failures. Add steps to rehydrate from short-term bucket if needed.

raja: Good. Action items: yvonne -> runbook + staging test; linh -> alerts/dashboard; I'll draft the compliance justification and compression tradeoffs. Meet tomorrow AM to approve canary.
